checkedOccurrences.textualBasisJa: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

wikipediaActualRead.title: Cities in the Book of Joshua
wikipediaActualRead.identityBasisJa: Wikipedia表はEleph/Ha-ElephをJoshua 18:28、Benjaminの町として同じ項目に掲載。WEB表記Elephと割当名Haelephの揺れを根拠付きで結び付ける。

geographyAssessmentJa: 地理種別はcity。候補位置は未確認候補として扱い、現代の市街地・遺跡境界の確定点とは表示しない。
